    if parent[x] != x:
        parent[x] = find(parent, parent[x])
    return parent[x]

    rootX = find(parent, x)
    rootY = find(parent, y)
    
    if rootX != rootY:
        if rank[rootX] > rank[rootY]:
            parent[rootY] = rootX
        elif rank[rootX] < rank[rootY]:

        else:

def kruskal(n, m, corridors):
